0-breakfast.title: Besan chilla, masala chana
0-breakfast.recipe: Mix besan with water, chopped onion, green chili, cumin and salt. Cook 2 medium chillas in a lightly oiled pan. Blend mint, coriander, green chili and lemon into chutney. Serve with a small bowl of roasted chana tossed with chaat masala.

0-lunch.title: Tandoori chicken, watana sabzi & bajra roti
0-lunch.recipe: Marinate 150 g chicken per serving in plain curd, ginger, garlic, lemon, red chili powder, cumin, coriander powder and garam masala in the fridge. Grill or air-fry until the thickest part reaches 74°C. Cook peas with onion, tomato, cumin, turmeric and salt, using 1–2 tsp oil for the sabzi. Serve with 1 bowl of peas and 1 small bajra roti made with bajra flour and water.

0-snack.title: Cucumber-tomato chaat, masala chai & makhana
0-snack.recipe: Toss chopped cucumber and tomato with lemon, chaat masala and chili flakes. Dry-roast makhana until crisp. Brew black tea with ginger and cardamom, add milk, and serve without sugar alongside the chaat and makhana.

0-dinner.title: Tandoori drumsticks, spinach & cucumber salad
0-dinner.recipe: Coat 2–3 chicken drumsticks per serving with plain curd, ginger, garlic, lemon, red chili powder, cumin, coriander powder, garam masala and salt; marinate in the fridge. Oven-bake or air-fry until the thickest meat reaches 74°C away from the bone. Sauté spinach with garlic using 1–2 tsp oil. Serve with a cucumber-onion salad dressed with lemon.

1-breakfast.title: Moong chilla, black chana
1-breakfast.recipe: Soak moong dal until softened, drain and blend with ginger, green chili, cumin, salt and water into a batter. Cook chillas in a lightly oiled pan. Soak black chana, drain and cook in fresh water until fully tender, then simmer with onion, tomato, cumin, turmeric and red chili powder. Serve a small bowl with the chillas and a chutney of coriander, mint, lemon and green chili.

1-lunch.title: Chicken curry, bhindi & roti
1-lunch.recipe: Cook onion, tomato, ginger, garlic, cumin, turmeric, red chili powder, coriander powder, garam masala and salt with 1–2 tsp oil. Add 150 g chicken per serving and water; simmer until chicken reaches 74°C. In a separate wide pan, cook sliced bhindi with cumin, turmeric and a little oil. Serve with 1 bowl of bhindi and 1 small roti made from atta and water.

1-snack.title: Masala chaas, peanuts, green tea & khakhra
1-snack.recipe: Whisk plain curd with water, roasted cumin, kala namak and chopped coriander to make chaas. Serve with roasted peanuts, unsweetened green tea and 2–3 whole-wheat khakhra.

1-dinner.title: Chicken & vegetable hakka noodles
1-dinner.recipe: Boil egg-free whole-wheat noodles according to the packet and drain. Stir-fry garlic, ginger and green chili in 1–2 tsp oil. Add 150 g chicken per serving and cook to 74°C, then shred. Add plenty of cabbage, carrot, capsicum and green beans; cook until just tender. Toss with noodles and a small splash of soy sauce and vinegar. Serve without extra roti or rice.

2-breakfast.title: Avocado toast, masala makhana
2-breakfast.recipe: Mash half an avocado per serving with lemon, chili flakes, black pepper and salt. Spread on toasted multigrain bread. Dry-roast makhana and toss with chaat masala; serve alongside.

2-lunch.title: Chicken tikka masala, cabbage & brown rice
2-lunch.recipe: Marinate 150 g chicken per serving in plain curd, ginger, garlic, lemon, red chili powder and garam masala in the fridge. Grill or air-fry to 74°C. Cook onion and tomato with cumin, coriander powder, turmeric, salt and 1–2 tsp oil; blend into a light gravy without cream. Add the chicken and simmer. Sauté cabbage with cumin and serve 1 bowl alongside a small bowl of cooked brown rice.

2-snack.title: Masala corn chaat, chai & roasted chana
2-snack.recipe: Cook sweetcorn and toss with chopped onion, tomato, coriander, lemon, green chili and chaat masala. Brew black tea with ginger and cardamom, add milk, and serve without sugar with a handful of roasted chana.

2-dinner.title: Masala chicken burger & side salad
2-dinner.recipe: Mix minced chicken with ginger, garlic, green chili, cumin, garam masala and salt; shape into a patty without egg. Grill in a lightly oiled pan until the centre reaches 74°C. Mix plain curd with mint, lemon and green chili for the sauce. Assemble in a multigrain bun with lettuce and tomato. Serve with a cucumber-onion salad dressed with lemon.

3-breakfast.title: Chia oats, cucumber dip
3-breakfast.recipe: Mix rolled oats and chia seeds with plain curd and enough milk to loosen. Add a small handful of dry fruits (4–5 pieces per serving), cover and refrigerate overnight without sugar or jaggery. Serve with cucumber sticks and a dip made from hung curd, roasted cumin, salt and mint.

3-lunch.title: Chicken curry, black chana & roti
3-lunch.recipe: Soak black chana, drain and cook in fresh water until fully tender. Make an onion-tomato masala with ginger, garlic, cumin, turmeric, red chili powder, coriander powder, garam masala and salt, using 1–2 tsp oil per dish. Divide the masala between two pans: simmer 150 g chicken per serving with water in one until it reaches 74°C, and the cooked chana in the other. Serve with 1 bowl of chana curry and 1 small roti made from atta and water.

3-snack.title: Murmura chaat, soya chaat & masala chai
3-snack.recipe: Cook soy chunks according to the packet, drain and squeeze well. Toss with a little oil, cumin and red chili powder, then roast until golden. Mix with onion, tomato, coriander, lemon and chaat masala. Separately toss puffed rice with chopped onion, tomato, coriander, lemon and chaat masala just before serving. Brew black tea with ginger, cardamom and milk; serve without sugar.

3-dinner.title: Peri-peri drumsticks & beans-carrot sabzi
3-dinner.recipe: Coat 2–3 chicken drumsticks per serving with plain curd, peri-peri seasoning, garlic and lemon; marinate in the fridge. Oven-bake or air-fry until the thickest meat reaches 74°C away from the bone. Sauté green beans and carrot with cumin, salt and 1–2 tsp oil; serve alongside.

4-breakfast.title: Avocado toast, masala chana
4-breakfast.recipe: Mash half an avocado per serving with lemon, chili flakes and chaat masala. Spread on toasted multigrain bread. Toss roasted chana with chaat masala and serve alongside.

4-lunch.title: Chicken kali mirch, bhindi & bajra roti
4-lunch.recipe: Cook onion, ginger, garlic and cumin in 1–2 tsp oil. Add 150 g chicken per serving, crushed black pepper, coriander powder, salt and a spoonful of plain curd; simmer with a little water until chicken reaches 74°C. Cook bhindi separately with cumin, turmeric and a little oil. Serve with 1 bowl of bhindi and 1 small bajra roti made from bajra flour and water.

4-snack.title: Buttermilk, makhana, chai & khakhra
4-snack.recipe: Whisk plain curd with water, roasted cumin and kala namak to make buttermilk. Serve with dry-roasted makhana. Brew black tea with ginger, cardamom and milk, without sugar, and serve with 2 whole-wheat khakhra.

4-dinner.title: Schezwan chicken & vegetable noodles
4-dinner.recipe: Boil egg-free whole-wheat noodles according to the packet and drain. Stir-fry ginger, garlic and 150 g sliced chicken per serving in 1–2 tsp oil, cooking the chicken to 74°C. Add plenty of cabbage, carrot, capsicum and green beans. Toss with noodles, a small spoonful of Schezwan sauce and a light splash of soy sauce and vinegar. Serve without extra roti or rice.

5-breakfast.title: Chia oats, sprouts chaat
5-breakfast.recipe: Mix rolled oats and chia seeds with plain curd and enough milk to loosen. Add a small handful of dry fruits (4–5 pieces per serving), cover and refrigerate overnight without sugar or jaggery. Cook sprouts until steaming hot, then toss with onion, tomato, coriander, lemon and chaat masala; serve alongside.

5-lunch.title: Chicken curry, watana curry & brown rice
5-lunch.recipe: Cook onion, tomato, ginger, garlic, cumin, turmeric, red chili powder, coriander powder, garam masala and salt with 1–2 tsp oil per dish. Divide the masala between two pans. Add 150 g chicken per serving and water to one pan; simmer until chicken reaches 74°C. Add peas and water to the other and cook until tender. Serve with 1 bowl of peas curry and cooked brown rice.

5-snack.title: Masala corn chaat, green tea & peanuts
5-snack.recipe: Cook sweetcorn and toss with chopped onion, tomato, coriander, lemon, green chili and chaat masala. Serve with unsweetened green tea and roasted peanuts.

5-dinner.title: Hariyali drumsticks, mixed vegetables & curd
5-dinner.recipe: Blend coriander, mint, green chili, ginger, garlic, lemon, plain curd, cumin and salt. Coat 2–3 chicken drumsticks per serving and marinate in the fridge. Oven-bake or air-fry until the thickest meat reaches 74°C away from the bone. Sauté carrot, green beans, capsicum and peas with cumin and 1–2 tsp oil. Serve with a small bowl of plain curd.

6-breakfast.title: Vegetable paratha, curd, chana
6-breakfast.recipe: Make a dough with atta, grated carrot, finely shredded cabbage, coriander, green chili, cumin, salt and water. Roll and cook 1 paratha per serving in a lightly oiled pan. Serve with plain curd and roasted chana tossed with chaat masala.

6-lunch.title: Chicken & vegetable biryani with raita
6-lunch.recipe: Cook onion, ginger, garlic, cumin, cinnamon, cloves, cardamom, turmeric, red chili powder and garam masala in 1–2 tsp oil. Add chicken, plain curd, mint, coriander and salt. Add extra carrot, green beans and peas, then rinsed basmati rice and enough water to cook. Cover and cook until the rice is tender and chicken reaches 74°C. Serve a small bowl with raita made from plain curd, cucumber, roasted cumin and salt.

6-dinner.title: Spicy chicken burger & coleslaw
6-dinner.recipe: Mix minced chicken with ginger, garlic, green chili, cumin, garam masala and salt; shape into a patty without egg. Grill with a little oil until the centre reaches 74°C. Toss shredded cabbage and carrot with lemon and a little egg-free mayonnaise for coleslaw. Mix a small amount of Schezwan sauce with egg-free mayonnaise. Assemble the patty, coleslaw and sauce in a multigrain bun.

green-juice.title: Green juice
green-juice.recipe: **7 AM:** Blend cucumber, spinach, lemon and ginger with water. Serve without added sugar.
